No. B520 Alien Battlefield.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit stood still, looking towards the massive ten-thousand-meter Eternal Spatial Rift.

“The accumulation speed of the World-Breaking Origin Force here is much faster than in the small-sized otherworldly battlefields. Is the size of the permanent spatial rift, not the number, what influences the accumulation of the World-Breaking Origin Force?”

Lin Yuan contemplated.

He had tried before, sending the Taiyin Primordial Spirit and Taiyang Divine Spirit to different small-sized otherworldly battlefields, approaching the eternal spatial rifts at the same time.

...

However, there was no significant enhancement effect on the increase of the World-Breaking Origin Force.

But now, approaching this ten-thousand-meter eternal spatial rift in the medium-sized otherworldly battlefield, Lin Yuan distinctly felt the difference.

“The initial speed of accumulating World-Breaking Origin Force at the Door to the Myriad Realms was one strand every three hundred and thirty-three days. The spatial rift in the small-sized otherworldly battlefield increased this speed to one strand every two hundred and ninety days.”

“Now…”

Lin Yuan closed his eyes again to confirm.

“It’s one strand every two hundred days!”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face. Accumulating one strand of World-Breaking Origin Force every two hundred days meant more than two strands could be accumulated in a year.

Compared to the initial speed of accumulation, it had almost doubled.

“I currently have seventeen strands of World-Breaking Origin Force,” Lin Yuan thought to himself. Seventeen strands of World-Breaking Origin Force, in theory, could support him to traverse seventeen times without interruption.

However, that was the most basic traversal, belonging to random traversal.

When Lin Yuan’s strength was not yet strong, even random traversal could bring him significant improvement.

After all, not being strong meant there was still a large distance to the limit. With endless dimensions and endless domains, even random traversal to a world would likely assist him.

But now…

Lin Yuan had already become an Eighth Layer Evolver, and for a large number of worlds, even if he traversed to them, the help he could gain would be extremely limited.

For example, the worlds Lin Yuan traversed to on his third and fourth traversal – not to mention breaking through the shackles, it was questionable whether he could even recover to his peak strength.

The most critical point is—

After Lin Yuan’s seventh traversal, which was to overcome the Heart Demon Tribulation, he concluded that—

The time Lin Yuan stayed in the world he traversed to related to the world’s own level.

Simply put, the higher the level of the world, the longer Lin Yuan’s stay, and vice versa.

…

Shortly thereafter.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit found the best position near that massive ten-thousand-meter Eternal Spatial Rift.

This position maximized the accumulation of World-Breaking Origin Force, eventually increasing the speed to one strand every one hundred and ninety-eight days.

“My inner world now…”

Lin Yuan felt the Taiyin World within his Qi Sea Dantian.

After reaching the Eighth Layer, even just a Primordial Spirit could open up an inner world.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit created a ‘Taiyang World’ filled with flames, and the Taiyin Primordial Spirit established the ‘Taiyin World.’

However, influenced by various factors, the inner worlds opened by the original self, the Taiyang Divine Spirit, and the Taiyin Primordial Spirit, differed.

The original self, holding both Taiyin Taiyang Taiji, with complete and perfect rules, initially opened up a world over seven hundred thousand li. After transformation by the liquid from the Mysterious Gourd, the inner world had swelled to a size of two million li in diameter.

Owing to mastering the Taiyang Rule, the inner world created by the Taiyang Divine Spirit also reached four hundred thousand li in diameter, stepping into the threshold of the Eighth Layer peak.

As for the Taiyin Primordial Spirit… the current inner world is only two hundred thousand li in diameter. It can be foreseen that once Lin Yuan comprehends the Taiyin Rule completely, his ‘Taiyin World’ will also reach a size of four hundred thousand li.”

“Unfortunately, the liquid in that gourd only has effects on life with flesh and blood, and has no effect on energy life forms,” the Taiyin Primordial Spirit shook its head slightly.

The cosmos is vast, giving birth to countless lives, among which flesh-and-blood beings form the mainstream. Yet, they are only the mainstream. Besides flesh-and-blood beings, there exist life forms made of energy.

So-called energy life forms are those without flesh and blood; their essence of life is the soul or other ethereal energies. Strictly speaking, Lin Yuan’s two Primordial Spirits could be classified as energy life forms.

Compared to flesh-and-blood life forms, energy life forms have many advantages, such as being immune to most physical attacks, etc.

Within human civilization, certain special bloodline traits and methods can temporarily realize the energy transformation of the body.

But these transformations are nothing compared to true energy life forms.

“For the time being, this Primordial Spirit of mine will need to be stationed here.” Lin Yuan glanced around.

The medium-sized otherworldly battlefield he deliberately chose, aside from having a permanent spatial rift, was selected because battles of high intensity rarely occur here.

This was to Lin Yuan’s satisfaction. Should a high-intensity battle occur, it might lead to a scene like the original small-sized otherworldly battlefield, where human Evolvers fled en masse.

Of course, in most high-intensity battlefields, human civilization Evolvers are generally at an advantage, actively hunting down different species.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan was still in closed-door cultivation.

The many trivial matters of the Main Star and the Milky Way Star Region were mostly delegated to his subordinates and overseen more closely by the Goddess of Wisdom.

There weren’t likely to be any problems.

After once again being reduced to dust and returning through the Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Blood Rebirth.’

Lin Yuan began to feel the changes in his physical body and inner world.

“The rate of improvement is getting slower…” Lin Yuan’s expression showed contemplation.

The first time he absorbed that drop of crimson liquid, Lin Yuan’s physical inner world doubled in size instantly.

With each subsequent absorption, the increase of the physical inner world became progressively smaller.

Lin Yuan wasn’t surprised by this; the fact that the liquid in the gourd could forcibly increase the base size of the inner world was already incredibly astonishing.
